notes: Before counts follow the previous production call graph: main loaded once, each mirrored file loaded and saved independently, and writable sync loaded and saved once.
The after benchmark drives the production manifest transaction, SyncService, and WritableSyncService with one shared manifest.
Fatal authentication, recoverable-error, conflict, metadata-existence, and unrelated-entry preservation are covered by focused tests.
Concurrent manifest writers use metadata revisions plus an in-process generation and only reread content when either changes.
Obsidian exposes indexed folder children but no portable recursive adapter listing, so the visible Writable subtree uses indexed traversal while hidden manifest access retains the adapter fallback.
